def analyze(n):
    I=G[n+' input']; O=G[n+' output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bg)
    tmpl=[c for c in C if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in C if len(c)==1]
    D={(i,j):O[i][j] for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]}
    out=[]
    for s in singles:
        col=I[s[0]][s[1]]
        # assign added cells nearest to s (greedy by distance, cluster)
        rem=set(D); clu=set(); 
        def dist(p,q): return abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])
        cand=sorted(rem,key=lambda p:dist(p,s))
        # take until a small gap? use k=5 and split when gap > 2
        ks=[]; cur=[cand[0]]
        for x in cand[1:]:
            if dist(x,cand[len(cur)])<=2: cur.append(x)
            else: ks.append(cur); cur=[x]
        ks.append(cur)
        add=min(ks,key=len(s))
        rel=tuple(sorted((p[0]-s[0],p[1]-s[1],D[p]) for p in add))
        # template containing col
        t=[t2 for t2 in tmpl if any(I[a][b]==col for a,b in t2)]
        print(n,'marker',s,col,'-> added rel',rel,'templates colors',[set(I[a][b] for a,b in tt) for tt in t])
    return I,O,D,tmpl,singles

# Rebuild clean f with hypothesis: each singleton color -> stamp containing it (maximizing match); place stamp so that the marker-colored cell of the stamp lands exactly on the singleton; among 8 transforms / anchors, pick minimizing non-bg conflicts (excluding own singleton); allow clipping.
def f(I,clip=True):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); bgc=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bgc)
    stamps=[c for c in C if len(c)>1]; sing=[c[0] for c in C if len(c)==1]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for s in sing:
        v=I[s[0]][s[1]]
        st=max(stamps,key=lambda t:any(I[a][b]==v for a,b in t))
        origin=(min(a for a,b in st),min(b for a,b in st))
        nlist=[(a-origin[0],b-origin[1],I[a][b]) for a,b in st]
        tcells=[(a,b) for a,b in st]
        best=None
        for i,op in enumerate(OPS.values()):
            tr=[op(a-origin[0],b-origin[1]) for a,b in tcells]
            for k,(br,bc) in enumerate(tr):
                if tr[k]!=nlist[k][:2] or nlist[k][2]!=v: continue
                orr=s[0]-br; occ=s[1]-bc
                oc=[(orr+x,occ+y) for x,y,_ in nlist]
                if clip and not all(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w for rr,cc in oc): continue
                others=sum(1 for p in oc if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and I[p[0]][p[1]]!=bgc and p!=s)
                key=(others,abs(orr)+abs(occ))
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,oc,k)
        if best is None: continue
        _,oc,k=best
        for j,nx in enumerate(nlist):
            pr,pc=oc[j]
            if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w:
                O[pr][pc]=nx[2]
    return O
for d in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    P=f(I); print(d,P==O)
